# nemau_kubernetes_node_pool (Resource)

A node pool in a cluster.

`replicas` and the autoscaler bounds change in place; changing the node size replaces the pool.

Declare additional pools with this resource rather than inside `nemau_kubernetes_cluster`, so that adding a pool does not recreate the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_kubernetes_node_pool" "batch" {
  cluster_name = nemau_kubernetes_cluster.prod.name
  name         = "batch"
  node_class   = "default-worker"

  vcpus   = 8
  ram_mb  = 16384
  disk_gb = 200

  replicas       = 2
  autoscaler_min = 2
  autoscaler_max = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the cluster: `nemau_kubernetes_cluster.<name>.name`.
- `name` (String) Pool name, unique in the cluster. A DNS label: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 63 characters at most.
- `node_class` (String) The node class. The only class is `default-worker`.

### Optional

- `autoscaler_max` (Number) Autoscaler upper bound. Declare it alongside `autoscaler_min`.
- `autoscaler_min` (Number) Autoscaler lower bound. Declare it alongside `autoscaler_max`.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk of each node, in GB. Changing it replaces the pool.
- `flavor_id` (String) Node flavor id. Mutually exclusive with the custom size.
- `labels` (List of String) Node labels, each `key=value`, at most 16. The key is a lowercase DNS label (letters, digits and hyphens, 63 characters at most); the value is letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, 63 characters at most. The API has no operation to change them in place: changing them replaces the pool.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory of each node, in MB. Changing it replaces the pool.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of nodes. Changes in place.
- `taints` (List of String) Node taints, each `key[=value]:Effect`, at most 16. Effect is `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule` or `NoExecute`; the key and value follow the rules of `labels`. Changing them replaces the pool.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of each node, set together with `ram_mb` and `disk_gb`. Changing it replaces the pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic id `<cluster_name>:<name>`.
